Native R strict flag, integer max, unknown participant, invalid effect, missing random slope, malformed source array, and conformal p-value/flag identity validations reject incorrect inputs. R condition class is not asserted equal to Python TypeError, ValueError or KeyError.

Default base-R graphics and invisible R audit line/p-value geometry unchanged. Strict mode returns a typed etr_nonlinear_scientific_artist_record with original source artist data, axes, titles, conditional legends and source-only p-value provenance; not an actual Python matplotlib.axes.Axes or a pixel-equivalent figure.
Precomputed source nested trial-level functional BLUPs, not refitted or collapsed to participant means. Scientific nested covariance and optimizer identity remain outside plotting review.

independent_review_status: Developer provisional bounded scientific source plot geometry; 0 independent certifications, exact-head R/Python CI unobserved.
